gloss: to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing mistake

definitions.gloss: to write incorrectly; to misspell; to make a writing error
definitions.explanation: To make a mistake while writing, such as writing the wrong character, spelling something incorrectly, or writing the wrong number.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えた。
⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}えたせい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かなかった→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The package didn't arrive because I wrote the address wrong.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧ (to make a mistake). This is a productive pattern in Japanese where a verb stem + ⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧ means 'to do [verb] incorrectly.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a kanji wrong
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a name incorrectly
- ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write an address wrong
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write a number wrong

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to read incorrectly
- ⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to mishear
- ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧: to say incorrectly

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes an object with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.
